name: Lean index/poke S14: controlled mainnet MVP deployment preparation
publication_boundary: DTR is user-published and consumed through real immutable locks. User reviews/pushes BTZ dependency-completion commits and checks their CI; no new DTR changes.
limitations: Configured official index is trusted for receiving-history contents/completeness.
Oldest staging windows are bounded at 256 rows; finite history drains by re-reading newer rows, with potentially quadratic read amplification.
Inbox/image/storage backpressure preserves unadmitted payments and progress; no arbitrary-traffic sustainability promise.
Fresh deployment only; funded deployment reset is not authorized.
Mainnet verification NOT_RUN; actual local dfx asset hosting PASS; full-update headroom, production capacity and actual cycle burn NOT_MEASURED.
Automatic payouts/refunds unavailable; public paid/prize launch remains gated.
Event Horizon sender disabled unless reviewed at installation; existing source configuration is immutable.
next_action: User reviews exact-commit CI, chooses public operational values and follows the operator runbook to create/fund/install, host and play. No DTR push or S15.
remote_ci_scope: NOT_RUN for the new corrective-closeout commits; the earlier staging/dependency history is recorded separately.
dtr_change_scope: No DTR changes in this corrective closeout; the original S14 shared APIs are already published.
financial_action_authority: User only; no Codex mainnet calls, funding or transfers.
asset_canister_hosting_scope: Actual dfx assets route on disposable local network; mainnet NOT_RUN
